page.notes: <note side="right">Quæ s 9; XXI. Act. 13. 2.</note> <note side="right">9. ἀγάπη [?]</note> Doubtful readings: "Cotonus" and "Veronus" (names) may be misread; "Missatico" as printed. Greek words printed in a small, worn type (λειτουργίας, λειτουργεῖν, ἱλαστήριον, ἀναιμακτὸν θυσίαν, ἐν ταῖς ἀγάπαις ὑμῶν σπιλάδες, and the Greek side notes) are uncertain and marked [?]. The top note "Quæ s 9;" is uncertain. The printed "perfectè" and "sa-crificio" are as read. Possible printing error in "Cœnano-stra" (hyphen-split line). The catchword "frigerio" is the first word of the next page.
